title: Message
description: One relay of information between agents. Devin sessions cannot talk to each other; the orchestrator mediates every exchange and emits it as a Message. This is what TeamChat renders as a feed and AgentGraph renders as an edge.

from_agent_id.description: Null when the orchestrator itself is speaking.

from_role.description: Author role, or 'orchestrator' for system-mediated relays.

to_role.description: Recipient role, or 'broadcast' when written to the blackboard for anyone.

kind.description: Speech act. Drives the icon and colour in TeamChat.

body.description: Markdown. The actual content relayed into the recipient's prompt.

refs.description: Pointers to the evidence behind this message.
